Médecin et mathématicien de Pavie. Son A: Physician and mathematician from Pavia. His Ars Magna (1545) published the solution of cubic equations.
Magistrate in Toulouse and mathematician. With Pascal, he laid the foundations of probability in 1654.
Seigneur écossais, inventeur des logarit: Scottish laird, inventor of logarithms (1614), which turn multiplications into additions.
Philosophe et mathématicien allemand. Il: German philosopher and mathematician. He invented calculus at the same time as Newton.
Mathématicien suisse. En 1736, il résout: Swiss mathematician. In 1736 he solved the Königsberg bridges problem and founded graph theory.
Mathématicien anglais. Il écrit la logiq: English mathematician. He wrote logic as an algebra of 0 and 1.
Mathématicien allemand. Il montre qu'il: German mathematician. He showed that some infinities are larger than others.
Logicien autrichien. Ses théorèmes d'inc: Austrian logician. His incompleteness theorems (1931) showed the limits of any proof.
Scribe égyptien. Il copie le papyrus Rhi: Egyptian scribe. He copied the Rhind papyrus, a collection of arithmetic problems, stating that he was copying an older text. He is the earliest mathematician whose name we know.
